mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above its 12-month moving average is associated with negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is low (UNRATE < 4.5%) and inflation is moderate (CPIAUCSL between 1.5% and 3.0%), the economy is in a 'Goldilocks' zone with strong growth and stable prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5% and CPIAUCSL between 1.5% and 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a rising GDP (GDPC1) signals strong growth momentum that precedes corporate earnings acceleration, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when GDPC1 is rising, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production level above 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 6.0% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are above their 12-month moving averages, it indicates broad-based consumer demand strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month moving average AND RSAFS > 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, 60-day SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
